preregistration_metadata.research_objective: Discriminate among visual object binding, spatial association prior, and mixed non-linear decoding; identify what ego-motion memory actually computes.

competing_hypotheses.description: Task identity cleanly selects one visible object from visual geometry, predicting egocentric vector to designated physical target.
competing_hypotheses.falsification_condition: A-correct or B-correct marginal accuracy not statistically superior to 50% chance (binomial p > 0.05) or dual-discrimination <= 25%.

competing_hypotheses.description: Task identity retrieves a learned canonical spatial expectation with minimal dependency on actual target physical coordinates.
competing_hypotheses.confirmation_condition: Interaction I ~ 0 and model g(z, e) = g_prior(e) fits held-out scenes better than visual selection.

competing_hypotheses.description: Task token and visual latent interact through distributed non-linear MLP layers without implementing a clean object-selection operator.
competing_hypotheses.confirmation_condition: Nonlinear interaction I != 0, but prediction aligns poorly with physical object displacement, and general MLP fit achieves lowest held-out MSE.

preregistered_statistical_tests.null_hypothesis: Held-out MSE of Additive Model == Held-out MSE of Selection Model
